result.raw_final:
For **checked baggage**, Qatar Airways has no single economy weight allowance: it varies by route and fare. For **carry-on baggage**, economy passengers may bring one piece weighing up to **7 kg (15 lb)**. Check your booking confirmation for your checked allowance.

FINAL ANSWER: Economy carry-on: 1 piece up to 7 kg (15 lb). Checked baggage varies by route; check your booking for the specific allowance.
